reformas-integrales.name: Complete renovations
reformas-integrales.short: We handle your entire project, from design to final handover.
reformas-integrales.metaDescription: Complete renovations of homes and commercial premises in Salvaterra de Miño, Ponteareas, Tui and the surrounding area. A single point of contact from start to finish.
reformas-integrales.intro: We transform your home or premises from top to bottom, with a single point of contact who coordinates all the trades.
body: A complete renovation is the best opportunity to adapt your home to the way you live: redistribute spaces, gain light, improve insulation and renew all the installations.
We are with you from the very first visit: we take measurements, advise you on materials and finishes, give you a fixed-price quote and plan the work to meet deadlines with no surprises.

banos.name: Bathrooms
banos.short: We design and renovate modern, functional and elegant bathrooms.
banos.metaDescription: Bathroom renovations in Salvaterra de Miño and the surrounding area: bathtub-to-shower conversions, tiling, shower screens and made-to-measure furniture.
banos.intro: We renovate your bathroom in just a few days with practical, easy-to-clean solutions built to last.
body: From replacing a bathtub with a shower tray to a complete bathroom renovation, we take care of every detail: waterproofing, falls, lighting and ventilation.
We help you choose wall and floor coverings, sanitaryware, taps and furniture to create a comfortable bathroom in the style you are looking for.

cocinas.name: Kitchens
cocinas.short: Made-to-measure kitchens with quality finishes and maximum functionality.
cocinas.metaDescription: Made-to-measure kitchen renovations in Salvaterra de Miño, Ponteareas, Tui and Vigo: units, worktops, appliances and installations.
cocinas.intro: We design kitchens tailored to you, making the most of every centimetre so that cooking is a pleasure.
body: We look at how you use your kitchen to propose the best layout: galley, L-shaped, U-shaped or with an island. We combine functionality and aesthetics with hard-wearing materials.
We take care of all the work: installations, wall and floor coverings, fitting of units, worktops and appliances, so you can start using it with no worries.

pladur.name: Drywall (Pladur)
pladur.short: Partition walls, ceilings, insulation and plasterboard solutions.
pladur.metaDescription: Drywall/plasterboard work in Salvaterra de Miño and the surrounding area: partition walls, suspended ceilings, wall linings, thermal and acoustic insulation.
pladur.intro: Laminated plasterboard solutions: quick, clean and with excellent insulation performance.
body: Drywall/plasterboard lets you redistribute spaces, create suspended ceilings with integrated lighting or improve the thermal and acoustic insulation of your home without heavy building work.
We work with certified systems and flawless finishes, ready to paint.
includes: Suspended ceilings and recessed lighting coves

pintura.name: Painting
pintura.short: Interior and exterior painting with flawless, long-lasting finishes.
pintura.metaDescription: Painters in Salvaterra de Miño, Ponteareas and Tui: interior and exterior painting, wall smoothing and anti-damp treatments.
pintura.intro: We refresh walls, ceilings and façades with careful preparation and top-quality paints.
body: A good finish starts with good preparation: we protect furniture and floors, repair cracks and smooth surfaces before painting.
We advise you on colours and types of paint for each room and leave everything clean when we finish.
includes: Interior painting of homes and commercial premises
Wall smoothing and removal of textured (gotelé) finishes

tejados-y-fachadas.name: Roofs and façades
tejados-y-fachadas.short: Roof and façade repair and maintenance, with a guarantee.
tejados-y-fachadas.metaDescription: Roof and façade repairs in Salvaterra de Miño and the surrounding area: leaks, waterproofing, re-roofing and façade refurbishment.
tejados-y-fachadas.intro: We protect your home against rain and damp, something essential in the Galician climate.
body: We inspect and repair roofs, fix leaks, replace tiles and gutters, and waterproof roofs and terraces.
On façades, we repair cracks, apply coatings and waterproofing, and improve insulation to increase comfort and save energy.

sections.h: What data we process and for what purpose
p: We process the data you provide to us through the contact form, by phone, email or WhatsApp (name, phone number, email, municipality and project description) for the sole purpose of handling your request and preparing the quote you have asked for.
The legal basis is your consent, which you give by submitting the form (Art. 6(1)(a) GDPR), and, where applicable, the taking of pre-contractual steps at your request (Art. 6(1)(b) GDPR).

We will keep your data for as long as necessary to handle your request and, thereafter, for the periods required by law. If you do not go on to hire our services, your data will be deleted within a maximum of one year.

We do not disclose your data to third parties unless legally required to do so. To provide the service, we use providers who act as data processors: web hosting (Vercel Inc.) and email delivery (Resend). These providers may process data outside the European Economic Area, with the appropriate safeguards provided for in the GDPR (EU-US Data Privacy Framework or standard contractual clauses).

You can exercise your rights of access, rectification, erasure, objection, restriction of processing and portability, and withdraw your consent at any time, by writing to {email} and stating the right you wish to exercise.
If you believe we have not processed your data correctly, you can lodge a complaint with the Spanish Data Protection Agency (AEPD) (www.aepd.es).
